build.note: Source survey read by script from saved raw EBX; no capture. The note cites no per-asset hashes; the asset hashes below were computed by this draft from the files in that raw root. Facts only, no balance interpretation.

question: Which structural differences in the serialized bipod chains (attachment, U_PRG, WB part lists, GS bindings) separate the Mk 24 (MRGGA) and EF88 from the VCR-2 (VHS2), M277 (XM7) and M121 A2 (MG5)?

headline: Bipod selector a5578cf4-546c-44ef-9a79-b84021406c17 (the GUID of shared U_WPM_BTM_Bipod01_W10) is bound in every GS under GRM_BipodDeployed_BTM_P50 (list Field_2296f84f).

In VHS2, XM7 and MG5 GS the same selector is ALSO bound in two more lists: Field_b53510be -> HipDispersion/GDM_Array_HipDispersion_BTM_P20 (priority 10) and Field_ee32ca16 -> DispersionIncrease/GBM_Increase_ADS_{40|35|30}_BTM_Bipod (priority 10; VHS2 = 40, XM7 = 35, MG5 = 30).
In MRGGA and EF88 GS the selector appears only under GRM_BipodDeployed_BTM_P50 (priority 6 and 21); their Field_b53510be and Field_ee32ca16 lists contain no a5578cf4 entry.

GS-wide diff (all bindings): in VHS2+XM7+MG5 and in neither MRGGA nor EF88: GBM_NoIncrease_Semi_P00@ba7bb6a2 (priority 100), HipDispersion/GDM_Array_HipDispersion_BTM_P20@a5578cf4, Recoil/GRM_Recoil_BTM_P20@99615ebe. In MRGGA+EF88 and none of the three: Recoil/GRM_Recoil_BTM_P30@99615ebe. GBM_NoIncrease_ERG_P00@15cff9ff is in MRGGA, EF88, VHS2, XM7 (not MG5); GBM_NoIncrease_Semi_P00 is in VHS2, XM7, MG5 only.
The WB part WPM_BTM_Bipod01_W10 (effects WME_EnableMountUp, WME_BipodTag) is in all five part lists (idx 13/29/46/59/27); this does not discriminate.

Attachment_*Bipod* and U_PRG_*Bipod* files are structurally identical across MRGGA, VHS2, XM7, MG5 (only own GUIDs and hashes differ; U_PRG Field_32cf19f5 is true only for MG5). They import no WPM/U_ATT/WM/CMU. EF88 has no Attachment_*Bipod* or U_PRG_*Bipod* file in its folder and its Equipment_EF88 references no bipod U_PRG.

WPM_BipodActive (selector f6bad488): external in XM7 only (idx 111); MRGGA has an inline part (WB obj[38], list idx 118) with selector f6bad488 and the same four effect classes; VHS2, MG5 and EF88 have neither. Condition object Class_e30e403c with f6bad488 exists in MRGGA, EF88, VHS2, XM7, not MG5.
WB import-route differences between the groups are unrelated to bipod (for example RailCover W05 in MRGGA+EF88; Magnifier/Flashlight FX in the other three).
sourceFacts.scope: Five weapons: MRGGA (Mk 24), EF88, VHS2 (VCR-2), XM7 (M277), MG5 (M121 A2); steps 1-2 import chains from the bipod attachment through two import levels, steps 3-4 parts, GUID-prefix scan and GS bindings. Decoding uses the site repo's frosty-ebx-decode.py Ebx class loaded in-process via stage9/B/common.py with SharedTypeDescriptors.ebx. Item keys use WM:/ for Common/Hardware/Weapons/_WeaponModifiers/.

inference: Serialized structure only: the Mk 24 and EF88 GS bind the bipod selector under the deployed-recoil modifier alone, while VCR-2, M277 and M121 A2 also bind the hip-dispersion and ADS-increase modifiers; the in-game spread indicator clips of the same day (separate receipt) show the matching difference for mounted against unmounted. The note itself states facts only.
unresolved: Whether the absent Field_b53510be / Field_ee32ca16 entries mean the deployed spread benefit is not applied at runtime, or is supplied by another route, is not settled by the bindings alone (the in-game clips and the site bug 25 entry address it).
The raw root of this note is not named in it; the capture folder client-new-check-2026-10-15 is used for the asset hashes here, as in the sibling survey notes of the same day.
siteImpact: Supports site attachment bug entry 25 (the mounted spread benefits are not applied on the Mk 24, EF88, Z84M and VSSM bipods; grip pods lack the ADS benefit), logged with entry 26 in commit ec30b0b. No data value changed from this note.
